...RESPONDENTS (BY SRI YOGESH D. NAIK, AGA FOR R.1;
SRI H.L. PRADEEP KUMAR, ADVOCATE FOR R.2 & R.3.)
 THIS PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 & 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO QUASH THE IMPUGNED GENERAL AWARD 10.04.2023 BEARING NO.
KIADB/LAQ/43/2022-23, PRODUCED AS ANNEXURE-A, IN RESPECT OF THE SCHEDULE PROPERTY LAND BEARING SY.NO.6/1 SITUATED AT DODDAGOLLAHALLI VILLAGE,
KUNDANA HOBLI, DEVANAHALLI TALUK, BENGALURU RURAL,
TOTALLY MEASURING 1 ACRE 11 GUNTAS, ETC.
 THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER 1.

The case of the petitioner is that lands bearing Sy.No.6/1 measuring to an extent of 1 acre 11 guntas and Sy.No.6/2, measuring to an extent of 2 acres 6 guntas at Doddagollahalli Village,
Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District, was acquired for purposes of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board ('KIADB' NC: 2024:KHC:31676 for short).
However, respondent no.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
It is further submitted by the petitioner is desirous of getting developed land instead of monetary compensation for the acquired land.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioner produce all the relevant documents to show that he is the owner of the properties acquired.
It is further submitted that if the policy of the Government permits allotment of developed land in lieu of monetary compensation, even that will be considered.

3. Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.

There is no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant Sri Shamanna vs State Of Karnataka on 7 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176621349/
